title: .jos Object Specification 2.0.0 — core schema
description: A .jos document: the minimum unit of intention. Core members only; vendor and product vocabulary lives in profiles.

jos.description: Format header — identifies version and kind

version.description: Specification version (semver). 1.0.0 and 2.0.0 documents are accepted; jos.version is authoritative (§2.1)

kind.description: Document kind (§4): atom, flow, service, persona (1.0.0) and template, crystal, directory, engine (2.0)

schema.description: URL to JSON Schema for validation

profiles.description: Profiles the document uses, each name/MAJOR (§10); a kernel validates the profiles it knows and ignores members of unknown ones

^x-.description: Extension data (SPEC-2.0 §2.5): preserved, hashed, never interpreted by the core
